PatchedVariantHierarchyBulkPatchRequest.description:
Atomic multi-row edit: either every update in the batch applies, or
none does — matching branch creation, which is already a single
transaction with no partial result.

Needs in context `pdc` (a ProductDataCollection bound to this job's INTER
data) and the job's `catalog` (a HierarchyCatalog). Duplicates don't block
an edit: the view checks them once the batch is written.

Structural problems (unknown id, unknown parent, cycle, a move deeper than
the family variant or into another one, an unknown option) are collected
across the whole batch, then raised together as a
VariantHierarchyIssuesError, so nothing is persisted.
